#0 sky — the disproportion staged in scale and pace: zoom 0.85 (the sky vaster than the dial), the slowest beat of the journey (auto-sky, rate 0.05 — the heavens' turning), pointer repel at 0.15 (receptive attention, near stillness); the reader's ◉ sits dark inside the dial's disc — the reading not yet made; no ancient consultation invented. #1 gearing — the gear train drives the field (morphEnabled, thetaRate 0.45; auto-gear triangle on speed — the wheel's drive); the scale-mark · becomes what it is to be read AS (☉): the record's own move — an inscription tells a reader what a mark is to be read as (no Greek wording asserted); the ? at the rim keeps the misread indication live; pointer vortex — the turning.

#2 cycles — the Metonic (gold) and Saros (teal) rings breathe counter-phase (never settling into one rhythm — the operations stay distinct); auto-metonic at rate 0.19 (authored to the 19-year span); ≈ bright at the base — the residual the mytheme carries; pointer attract/pulse gentle — the reader consulting.

#3 wreck — THE 3D SCENE. z is the direction of reconstruction: the surviving fragment mass deep (z −0.45, gold dimming and resurfacing), the fragment plate (square) opens into the proposed ring arrangement rising to z +0.15 and returns to the plate — the model returning to its stated limit ("not a replica of the original"), the 9 outputs nearest the viewer (z +0.35); depth occlusion with a bronze tint; pointer attract/implode — the reconstruction gathering. The withholding pays off here exactly as bounded.

#4 native — the local pressure of the last two movements: X/x (capacity and particular, held at the rim) walks to the return station as 1/0 — the dial's exact indication reopening its horizon; the Neumann ground disc and Taylor relation ring keep their different objects; pointer repel/shove — differentiation's cut retained; the refraction stays Argued (no Neumann-attribution, no eight-components claim).

#5→0 return — the instrument returns to making: the coordinating yantra centre-bright, the reader's ◉ now bright (judging), the exposed-terms square lit gold (the constructive demand reachable by resistance), the heavens still beyond the dial (ring at 0.35 — unchanged as condition); pointer attract at 0.7 — participation. ENDING QUALIFIES BEGINNING: #0's sky was received by a dark reader at zoom 0.85 with pointer 0.15; #5→0 returns the same dial composition with the reader bright, the terms exposed, zoom restored to the hand's scale — reception become participation, the exactness preserved (the mechanism still coordinates) while the horizon reopens (the heavens beyond). The Offered band is untouched: architectural body, A32 and Agentworld remain proposal and test, never implementation.

glyph_rationales.☉: the Sun's indication at the dial: one celestial office the instrument coordinates (Freeth 2006's reported functions); at #1 it is the inscription — the mark a reader is taught to read as the Sun.
glyph_rationales.☽: the Moon's indication: lunar phase and position, a different office from the calendar's, coordinated not merged (#0).
glyph_rationales.≈: the residual: the astronomical fit stays approximate while the material ratio is exact as an arrangement (the Metonic/Saros distinction, #2).
glyph_rationales.9: the nine outputs of the proposed front display — Moon, Nodes, Mercury, Venus, Sun, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Date — a model fitted to fragments, not a recovered machine (#3).
glyph_rationales.X/x: Taylor's determination: the determining capacity related to the indefinite particular — the native mark of the instrument's X/x (#4).
glyph_rationales.1/0: the return: the achieved determination given back to its ground — source, mark and recognition closing the native field (#4).
glyph_rationales.◉: the reader: the active term whose question lets a display answer; dark within the dial at #0's beginning, judging in the open at #5→0.
glyph_rationales.the heavens — beyond possession: the sky that exceeds every arrangement of it: what the dial answers to without possessing (#0).
glyph_rationales.the dial — small, situated, productive i: the drawn instrument: a small material arrangement placing celestial relations before a life lived among them; its smallness makes the answer usable (#0).
glyph_rationales.the reader — within the world being read: the observer at the dial, standing inside the heavens the device helps disclose (#0).
glyph_rationales.the wheel — one part moves in relation t: the toothed wheel as drawn: gearing gives differentiated movement a transmissible body (#1).
glyph_rationales.the mesh — motion handed on: the small wheel's turning, handed to its neighbour: material constraint, not metaphor (#1); its rotation is the scene's one motion.
glyph_rationales.the train — motion carried through: the engine's cymatic interference: continuous motion carried through the arrangement, the mechanism's working made visible (#1).
glyph_rationales.the scale — makes the movement readable: the flat square of the dial's face: the scale that turns motion into a readable indication (#1).
glyph_rationales.the inscription — the mark read as the S: the convention that tells a reader what a mark is to be read as — motion, mark and interpretation performing different work (#1).
glyph_rationales.the Metonic cycle — the chosen count of: 19 years ≈ 235 lunations: a chosen calendar count, breathing through its steps as a count turns (#2).
glyph_rationales.the Saros — eclipse recurrence, another: eclipse recurrence: a different operation whose ring keeps its own size and office, coordinated not merged (#2).
glyph_rationales.the moon's phases — recurrence made visi: the drawn phase-strip ( ( ( O ) ) ): recurrence as the moon itself shows it — the sky's own count beside the chosen ones (#2).
glyph_rationales.the residual — where the count does not: ≈ marks where the count does not exhaust the sky: attunement includes the possibility of discrepancy (#2).
glyph_rationales.the sea surface — the find-place, not th: the shipwreck strait: Antikythera names the find-place; the name does not establish the workshop (#3).
glyph_rationales.Fragment A — the achieved work, survived: the corroded mass with its gear circle still showing: modern investigators encounter an achieved work through surviving parts (#3).
glyph_rationales.fragments toward arrangement — reasoning: the square of reasoned framing opening into the ring of the proposed display and back: filling absent parts is reasoning whose warrant stays distinguishable from evidence (#3).
glyph_rationales.the nine outputs — proposed, not recover: the 2021 proposal's count, kept in notation: model coherence supports it; lost evidence prevents claiming a replica (#3).
glyph_rationales.the instrument — determinate expression: the made thing as a determinate expression whose intelligibility depends on what it differentiates (#4).
glyph_rationales.the field it differentiates — the heaven: the wider field the instrument differentiates and returns to: Neumann's whole received without merging the histories (#4).
glyph_rationales.the whole — Parent and Return bracketing: nested squares: the native eightfold with Parent and Return bracketing the six positions — not eight machine components (#4).
glyph_rationales.X/x — determining capacity and the parti: Taylor's own determination in the native field; the psychic refraction enters only after this relation is established (#4).
glyph_rationales.1/0 — the achieved determination returne: the final native movement: exactness preserved while the horizon reopens (#4).
glyph_rationales.the dial, again — craft within knowing a: the dial redrawn mid-reading: technē and poiēsis — the instrument returns to making, the pointer now in the act (#5→0).
glyph_rationales.the heavens beyond the dial: the sky continuing past every indication: a reading can end in use, a renewed question, or setting the instrument down (#5→0).
glyph_rationales.exposed terms — the conditions resistanc: the square of disclosed conditions: retained source, disclosed measure, reversible coordination — resistance must reach them (#5→0).
glyph_rationales.the reader — judging, within the world r: the reader still judging: the mechanism continues to coordinate, and the person remains available beyond the answer (#5→0).
